title: Key West Sandbar Safari on One of a Kind Tiki Boat
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Picture yourself aboard our unique tiki boat, the Lazy Lady, cruising through the crystal-clear waters toward a secluded sandbar. The sun is shining bright, and the air is filled with the scent of salt and sunshine. As you approach the sandbar, the boat glides over shallow waters, revealing stretches of soft, white sand inviting you to explore.

Once you anchor, the fun begins! You can jump off the boat and wade into the warm, shallow waters, where the gentle waves lap at your feet. The atmosphere is relaxed, with laughter and conversation floating through the air. Some folks might set up beach games, while others enjoy swimming or soaking in the sun.

Time seems to slow down as you enjoy this little slice of paradise, surrounded by friends or newfound acquaintances. Whether you’re collecting seashells, taking a dip, or simply lounging in the sun, a sandbar trip on a tiki boat is a perfect blend of relaxation and adventure.
